choose.description: Use one value when something is true and another when it isn't, without an If around other steps. For example, if an order is urgent use “[URGENT] ”, otherwise nothing.
choose.name: choose

parameters.description: What decides the value. Compare values the way an If step does, like Priority is High.
parameters.name: condition

parameters.description: The value when the condition is true.
parameters.name: then

parameters.description: The value when it isn't. Leave empty for nothing.
parameters.name: otherwise

returns.description: The value for whichever way the condition went, or empty text when it isn't true and there is nothing to use otherwise.

else.description: Run these steps when the matching “If” condition is not true.
else.name: else

returns.description: No output. The steps after Otherwise run when the If condition is not true.
No output. This marks the end of the If.

if.description: Choose steps to run only when something is true. For example, continue only if an order is over $100 or an email came from a specific person.
if.name: if

parameters.description: The condition that decides which branch runs. Compare values, or describe it in your own words and let the workflow judge.
parameters.name: condition

returns.description: No output. The steps inside the If run only when its condition is true.
